summary: Starwood Real Estate Income Trust filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing its September 2026 monthly distribution declaration. The board declared gross distributions of $0.0770 per share for Class I, D, T, and S common stock, with net distributions of $0.0770, $0.0731, $0.0635, and $0.0634 respectively after stockholder servicing fees. Distributions are payable to holders of record as of September 30, 2026, with payment on or about October 5, 2026, in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. No special-situation event, transaction, or strategic action is present; this is a recurring dividend notice.
